name: Lucifer C. Sunrays
original_name: ルシフェル・Ｃ・サンレイズ
source:
Although she lost her memories of her past life, and she was taken to Hell without knowing anything. 

She has a blunt and honest personality, and isn't even frightened by the presence of an angel. 

Using throwing knives and moving with wires, she prefers close-quarters combat. A meat-loving glutton.

[Translated from [url=https://warabimochipizzacha.wixsite.com/heavensroyale]official website[/url]]
